3532-5078-5240-8346.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Oneirophage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

489-1621-6867-6967.description:
Cast Appa by paying {W}{W}
When Appa enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Wispweaver Angel with the ability to cast it later from exile.
Cast Wispweaver Angel from exile by paying {0}.
Appa's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token
When Wispweaver Angel enters, it triggers, blinking Appa.
Repeat from step 2.

719-997-4302.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
719-997-4302.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Bishop of Wings' second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
When the Spirit token enters the battlefield as an Angel due to Xenograft, Bishop of Wings' first ability triggers, causing you to gain 4 life.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

2099-3490-5445-7426.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on Berta.
2099-3490-5445-7426.description:
Activate Sarcatog by sacrificing another artifact
Tarrian's Soulcleaver triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Berta.
Berta and Animation Module trigger.
Resolve the Berta trigger, adding {1}.
Resolve the Animation Module trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Resolve the Sarcatog ability.
Repeat

uses.n: Tetzin, Gnome Champion // The Golden-Gear Colossus

1379-2388-6587-7309.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill The Golden-Gear Colossus.
1379-2388-6587-7309.description:
Declare The Golden-Gear Colossus as an attacker. It triggers, creating two 1/1 Gnome artifact creature tokens and transforming Ultimecia, Time Sorceress into Ultimecia, Omnipotent.
Ultimecia, Omnipotent triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Don & Leo triggers, blinking Ultimecia, Omnipotent. It'll enter the battlefield as Ultimecia, Time Sorceress.
When Ultimecia, Time Sorceress enters, it triggers, causing you to surveil 2.
Repeat each turn.

855-1806-2060-5256-7367.description:
Activate Eternal Scourge's scavenge ability, granted to it by Young Deathclaws, by paying {3} and exiling Eternal Scourge from your graveyard, putting six +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler due to Corpsejack Menace.
Activate Crystalline Crawler six times by removing six +1/+1 counters from it, adding {6}.
Cast Eternal Scourge from exile by paying {3}.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Eternal Scourge.
Repeat.

2266-3430-6006.description:
Activate Phyrexian Ironfoot by tapping it, adding three snow mana of any color.
Activate Phyrexian Ironfoot by paying {1}{S}, untapping it.
Repeat.

4038-4880-5963.description:
Activate Marvin using Weaver of Currents's ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Marvin using Farmstead Gleaner's ability by paying {2} and untapping it, putting a +1/+1 counter on Marvin.
Repeat.

2281-2511-4681.description:
Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Karmic Guide
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Karmic Guide
When Karmic Guide dies, Saffi triggers, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Saffi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

2724-3080-5299-7068.description:
Cast Exchange of Words by paying {1}{U}{U}.
When Exchange of Words enters the battlefield, it triggers, exchanging the text boxes of it and Wormfang Manta.
Activate Baboon Spirit by paying {3}{U}, exiling Wormfang Manta
At the beginning of your end step, Baboon Spirit triggers, returning Wormfang Manta from exile to the battlefield.
Exchange of Words leaves and enters the battlefield, triggering the second ability it gained from Wormfang Manta's textbox as well as its own ability.
Resolve the first Exchange of Words trigger, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Resolve the second Exchange of Words trigger, exchanging the text boxes of it and Wormfang Manta.
Repeat from step 3 during each turn.

141-997-6475.description:
Cast Reunion of the House by paying {5}{W}{W}.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying {2}{U}{U}.
When Naru Meha enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Reunion of the House.
Holding priority, activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Reunion of the House, targeting Naru Meha and any other creature(s) as desired.
Resolve the copy of Reunion of the House, returning the targeted creatures from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

222-527-1251-5686.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-1251-5686.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Shilgengar twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

uses.n: The Enigma Jewel // Locus of Enlightenment

74-943-2404.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two creatures.
74-943-2404.description:
Activate Gaea's Cradle by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}.
Activate Deserted Temple's second ability by paying {1} and tapping it, targeting itself.
Locus of Enlightenment triggers, copying Deserted Temple's ability, targeting Gaea's Cradle.
Resolve both Deserted Temple abilities, untapping it and Gaea's Cradle.
Repeat.
74-943-2404.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may untap any other land except Gaea's Cradle instead.

1494-5395.notablePrerequisites:
Piper has power 5 or greater.
Piper does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked by an opponent.
1494-5395.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Piper.
Piper's first ability triggers, creating at least five Clue tokens.
Activate a Clue by paying {2} and sacrificing it.
Piper's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Sage of Hours.
Resolve the Clue ability, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 3 four additional times.
Activate Sage of Hours by removing all +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

2366-3518-5129-5751-5761.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least one additional land card in hand.
There are at least four card types among cards in your graveyard, excluding Crop Sigil.
2366-3518-5129-5751-5761.description:
Cast Crop Sigil from your graveyard for its retrace cost by paying {G} and discarding Dryad Arbor.
Cast Lion's Eye Diamond from your graveyard for its retrace cost by discarding another land in your hand.
When Lion's Eye Diamond enters the battlefield, Mirrorworks triggers.
Holding priority, activate Lion's Eye Diamond by sacrificing it and discarding your hand, adding three mana of any color.
Resolve the Mirrorworks trigger, causing you to pay {2} to create a token copy of Lion's Eye Diamond.
Activate the Lion's Eye Diamond token by sacrificing it and discarding your hand, adding {G}{G}{G}.
Activate Crop Sigil by paying {2}{G} and sacrificing it, returning Dryad Arbor and another land card from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2060-3961-4613-4868.notablePrerequisites: Tekuthal has at least one indestructible counter on it, and at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
2060-3961-4613-4868.description:
Activate Tekuthal using Myojin of Towering Might's ability by removing an indestructible counter from it, putting six +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler, and two +1/+1 counters on any creature you control.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability three times by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {3}.
Activate Tekuthal by paying {3} and removing three +1/+1 counters from Crystalline Crawler, putting an indestructible counter on it.
Repeat.

1881-3693-5220.description:
Cast Walking Ballista either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Walking Ballista enters the battlefield and dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
Mortuary triggers, putting Walking Ballista on top of your library from your graveyard.
Repeat.

767-3008-3048-4186.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature.
Druids' Repository has at least one charge counter on it.
767-3008-3048-4186.description:
Activate Blade of Shared Souls' equip ability by paying {2}, attaching it to another creature you control.
Blade of Shared Souls triggers, causing the creature it is attached to to become a copy of Roalesk.
Put the creature with Blade of Shared Souls attached into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The creature triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Scurry Oak and two charge counters on Druids' Repository.
Scurry Oak triggers twice, creating two 1/1 Squirrel creature tokens.
Activate Druids' Repository twice by removing two charge counters from it, adding {2}.
Repeat.

2034-2308-5104.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2034-2308-5104.description:
Gain any amount of life.
Trudge Garden triggers, causing you to pay {2} to create a 4/4 Fungus Beast creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Fungus Beast, adding {C}{C}.
When the Fungus Beast dies, Nadier's Nightblade triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.
